page.layout: One page of text in a single column. Running head centred at top, page number at top right. Glosses in smaller type sit within and below the text as short annotation lines, each a separate foot paragraph. A heading "Ad caput" stands centred near the foot, followed by the paragraph beginning with a large initial. Signature at bottom left, catchword at bottom right.

main_text.p: κα[?]ὶ ἀϑὺς [?]τῆς ἀνδρῶν. Intelligit igitur Theophraftus appellatione ὀλιγαρχίας, mores hominis, qui optimatium fectam fequitur. Defcriptio oligarchiæ ab auctore prodita corrupta eft. Legimus nos ita, φι-λαρχία τις ἰσχυρὰ κέρδους ἢ γλιχομένη, vel γλιχομένης, id eft, vehemens honorum cupiditas, in eo qui nullo ftudio lucri teneatur. Aliter ifta conftituere quiti non fumus.
ὁ ἢ ὀλιγαρχ[?] θι.) Legendum, ὀλιγαρχικός.

οἱ[?] τὲ ϑ νῦμ βυλομένυ.) Et mutilus & corruptus eft hic locus. Nos vertimus quafi effet fcriptum, οἱ δὲ τῶν βουλομένων τινὰς [ ϑὲι αἱρεῖσϑαι ] τῶ ἀρ-χονῖι συνεπιμελη⊙μένυς παρὰ ταῦτης, παρελϑὼν, ὑπο-φῆναι ἑαυτόν.
Δεῖ αὐτὺς κ[?]αμί. ] Legi Οὐ ϑεῖ αὐτὺς κ.
Ϲϑεῖν τὰς Ϲϊϊτυς λόγυς. ] Lego σ.ἡ τ. λόγυς λέγων. Et accipio Ϲϑεῖν pro δ[?]ὰ τῆς ἀγορᾶς Ϲϑεῖν, quomodo loqui amant Græci.

τὸν Θησέα φρῶν φήϛς. ] Lego, φρῶν αἴτιον φ. Malum illud cuius auctor primus dicitur fuiffe Thefeus,eft ἰϹμοιεία & equaliras inter ciues,quam primus ille Athenas inuexit, & fanxit. Lege Plutarchum, & optimatem ifta loqui memento: cui in ordinem cogi, & non αἰὲν ϑεισϑῆν ἐ ὑπείροχον ἐμμεναι ἄλλων, inftar mortis eft.
καὶ ϑιαῦξ ἕτερα.] Deeft verbum λέγειν.
main_text.head: Ad caput ὡσὲ ὁμοιοϑίας.
main_text.p: Hδὲ ὁμοιοϑίας φ.] Appellat Theophraftus ὁμοιοϑίαν, non quòd proprie vox Græca fonat,

page.notes: The Greek in the first line and in the glosses is only partly legible at this scan resolution; doubtful letters are marked [?]. The gloss "Legi Οὐ ϑεῖ" and the Greek in the gloss "οἱ⊙ τὲ ϑ νῦμ" are the least certain readings. The large initial H is joined to the gloss "δὲ ὁμοιοϑίας φ.]" as it appears on the line. The heading "Ad caput" is a title above a passage and set as level 2. No marginal notes outside the text block are visible.
